\begin{figure}[t]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{figures/dynamic-regularized-graph.pdf}
\caption{New bounded-denominator nonstationary companion
(\texttt{nonstat\_regularized}), $T=3$, with a single change point at $t=1$.
(a) The fine graph contains all 14 equation-parent edges:
$X_t\to Z_t\to Y_t$ in each slice, self-lags for $X,Z,Y$,
$X_0\to Z_1$ at the change point and $Z_1\to Y_2$ in the subsequent regime.
(b) The quotient under $C_t=\{X_t,Z_t\}$, with $Y_t$ remaining a singleton,
contains eight distinct edges. Within-cluster $X_t\to Z_t$ edges vanish;
$X_0\to Z_1$ coalesces with the existing $C_0\to C_1$ edge, whereas
$Z_1\to Y_2$ induces $C_1\to Y_2$. Solid black denotes within-slice links
and self-lags; dashed red denotes the additional cross-variable lags.
Independent exogenous disturbances are omitted. The change-point mechanism
is $Z_1=-X_1/\sqrt{1+X_0^2}+Z_0+\varepsilon_{Z,1}$, with denominator
bounded below by one. This is a separately defined companion SCM,
not the original nonstationary benchmark.}
\label{fig:dag-dynamic-regularized}
\end{figure}
